title: Kangri language
description: Western Pahari language of north India
extract: Kangri is a Western Pahari language, spoken in Himachal Pradesh, predominantly in the Kangra district, Hamirpur district and hilly parts of Una district as well as in some parts of Mandi and Chamba districts of Himachal Pradesh and in hilly parts of Pathankot and Hoshiarpur districts of Punjab. It is also spoken in few villages of Pakistan by the people belonging to the families migrated from Kangra region. It is associated with the people of the Kangra.
